description: This file defines a generic data service class `CatalogLookupDataService` for retrieving lookup data from an API in a Blazor application. It utilizes dependency injection, generic type constraints, and reflection to determine the API endpoint. The service implements methods to fetch and return a list of lookup data items.

classes.name: CatalogLookupDataService<TLookupData, TReponse>
classes.description: A generic service class for fetching lookup data from an API in a Blazor app.

methods.description: Constructor injecting HttpClient, configuration options, and logger; initializes API URL.

methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a list of lookup data items from the API.
